problem_codes.title: Invalid parameter
problem_codes.remedy: Check the parameter against the operation's reference.

problem_codes.title: Unknown parameter
problem_codes.remedy: Remove the parameter the operation does not declare.

problem_codes.title: Cursor does not match the filters
problem_codes.remedy: Send the cursor only with the filters it was issued for, or start again without a cursor.

problem_codes.title: Not covered
problem_codes.remedy: Search for the company with GET /v1/companies?q=…, or read its coverage with GET /v1/companies/{company}?expand=coverage.

problem_codes.title: Excluded
problem_codes.remedy: Use other content; this item is not available under your licence.

problem_codes.title: Not found
problem_codes.remedy: Check the id, or list the collection to find a valid one.

problem_codes.title: Plan required
problem_codes.remedy: Upgrade the plan, or use an operation of your tier (GET /v1/me).

problem_codes.title: Insufficient credits
problem_codes.remedy: Wait for the next period or add credits (GET /v1/me/usage).

problem_codes.title: Rate limited
problem_codes.remedy: Retry after the number of seconds in Retry-After.

problem_codes.title: Idempotent request in flight
problem_codes.remedy: Retry the same request after the first one answers.

problem_codes.title: Internal error
problem_codes.remedy: Retry once, and report the request_id if it repeats.

problem_codes.title: Unauthorized
problem_codes.remedy: Send a valid key as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

problem_codes.title: Forbidden
problem_codes.remedy: Use a key that may call this operation.

problem_codes.title: Service unavailable
problem_codes.remedy: Retry after the number of seconds in Retry-After.
